postPublishHostAcceptance.reason: the published bytes are byte-identical to the pin (verified by the anonymous download and the byte comparison above), and that exact content already passed both real host acceptances recorded in docs/evidence/dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.json and docs/evidence/dsh-0.2.1-alpha.1.json, which pack:check re-verified against this content digest and tarball digest. This is a deliberate difference from the rc.3-rc.11 records, which ran the acceptance again against the downloaded release.
